buttonPaint: styles.css maps a.button.primary to the gen-A lime StyledButton (za-btn za-btn-primary), a.button.secondary to the outlined za-btn-secondary; under body.legacy both take the gen-B teal square zb-btn look. Blocks that need a canon variant (za-btn-sm, za-btn-on-dark) put the class on their own wrapper and style the authored anchor through it; never manufacture anchors.
sectionMetadata: rendered server-side: Section Metadata style -> class on the section div (one style value per section)
classNaming: kebab-case only (stylelint selector-class-pattern): the canon BEM names are flattened, za-hdr__bar -> za-hdr-bar, za-btn--primary -> za-btn-primary, zb-footer__col -> zb-footer-col
mediaQueries: mobile-first only (breakpoint-lint in npm run lint); gen A steps 481/768/970/1150/1600, gen B 768/1200

foundationPrimitives.defaultContent: main > .section > .default-content-wrapper is a za-container; its p/li take the za-text type

fonts.loading: styles/fonts.css via loadFonts(); metric-matched vanilla-sans-fallback / sharp-sans-fallback / proxima-nova-fallback in styles.css; nothing in head.html

chrome.header: blocks/header reads getMetadata('nav') (default /nav); sections of the nav doc are typed by Section Metadata style: promo | brand | utility | menu | menu-feature | tools | mobile-bar | drawer
chrome.footer: blocks/footer reads getMetadata('footer') (default /footer); styles: columns | help | social | legal | brand | newsletter
chrome.stickyBars: after load body > header, .header-wrapper and .header.block are display: contents, so #za-hdr-m / #za-hdr-d (gen A) and .zb-header (gen B) stick to the page; keep those ids/classes for chrome-parity regions
chrome.navHeightReservation: --nav-height per breakpoint in styles.css: promo + bar 170/182/220/168 (0/481/970/1150); promo off 60/72/110; nav-slim 60/72/91; legacy 68/110 with header margin-bottom -128px (the legacy header overlays the story hero)

documents./nav: gen A full header with promo strip (default)
documents./nav-pricing: gen A full header, CTAs Try for free + Contact Sales, mobile Try for free (pricing page)
documents./nav-slim: gen A reduced header: logo + CTAs, no promo/secondary row/menus (contact, form and landing pages)
documents./footer-legal: gen A slim legal footer: logo + legal links (contact, form pages)

pageMetadata.genB: customer stories (/customer/<name>/): Metadata rows  nav | /nav-legacy ;  footer | /footer-legacy ;  theme | legacy  (theme -> body.legacy before first paint: gen-B fonts, ground, buttons and the 68/110 header reservation)
pageMetadata.promoOff: promo | off  drops the CX Trends strip (pages whose live header has no promo: company, pricing, contact, …); styles.css reads the meta tag with :has() so the reservation matches before the header loads

chrome.pageLevelChromeDeltas: left to the archetype units (template class on body via Metadata template): blog's relative (non-sticky) global header under its sticky sub-nav, blog's footer inside main
chrome.behaviour: gen A: desktop mega menus open on hover/focus-within (Escape closes), language menu likewise; locale links take the current path; mobile drawer (< 970) with per-menu sub-panels (back/close), pinned View demo + Contact us; .is-stuck only on bars whose computed position is sticky. gen B: hover/focus dropdowns, Resources-style active underline from the current path, accordion drawer mounted on first toggle, sticky after the secondary row (top -1 / -29)
chrome.icons: /icons/za-*.svg and zb-*.svg, inlined by scripts/chrome.js (currentColor); authored in the chrome docs as :za-name: tokens

links: in-scope pages (stardust/.labs/site-plan.json) root-relative with the source trailing slash; out-of-scope and D5 (/login/, /register/) absolute https://www.zendesk.com/…; localize-links.mjs normalizes as pages arrive
martech: scripts/martech.js loadConsent() in loadEager, consent-check.js -> consented.js -> loadTags() in loadDelayed; every contract part disabled (unchanged)
lint: npm run lint = eslint (stardust/ ignored: tooling, captured tags, prototypes) + stylelint + breakpoint-lint
